payload.name: Perceptual Fluency Effect on Brand Preference
payload.fact: Changing the spatial location of brand logos or product depictions across repeated ad exposures increases perceptual fluency, which enhances logo preference and brand choice.
payload.boundary: Effect is incidental; participants could not accurately report which elements changed location.

provenance.title: What the Blind Eye Sees: Incidental Change Detection as a Source of Perceptual Fluency
provenance.quote_or_locus: Three experiments demonstrate that brand logos and product depictions capture greater fluency when they change location in an advertisement from one exposure to the ad to the next. As a consequence, logo preference and brand choice are enhanced
